state.prospect_message: To be upfront, we haven't set aside any money for this yet and there's no hard date on our side. What I can tell you is how it would work: any new tool goes through our security review first, then Marta in procurement handles the contract, and our VP of Operations makes the final call after a side-by-side of the shortlisted vendors.

rationale: The message describes who decides, the review and procurement steps, and how shortlisted vendors will be compared, which is a decision-process signal; saying no money is set aside and no date exists states neither an amount nor a date, so there is no second signal and multiple_signals_stated does not apply.

state.requirement: The vendor must provide single sign-on using SAML 2.0 with the customer's identity provider.
state.proposal_section: Quillbridge supports SAML 2.0 single sign-on with any standards-compliant identity provider. The customer administrator completes the configuration in the security settings, and our onboarding team assists during setup.

rationale: The section states the requirement is met as written and describes how.

state.requirement: All customer data must be hosted in a data center located within the customer's country.
state.proposal_section: Quillbridge hosts all customer data in our two regional facilities in a neighboring country. In-country hosting is not offered at this time; we propose the regional option with contractual data-residency commitments as an alternative.

rationale: The section states the requirement will not be met as written and offers an alternative.

state.requirement: The vendor must provide an audit log of administrative actions retained for one year.

rationale: The proposal section is empty, so there is nothing to read against the requirement.

state.requirement: The system must retain audit logs for seven years and allow authorized administrators to export those logs in CSV format on demand.
state.proposal_section: Audit log retention: Meridian retains every audit event for the full seven-year period in immutable storage, with retention enforced by policy rather than by manual process. Export: Meridian does not provide CSV export of audit logs. Logs are exported on demand as newline-delimited JSON, which we propose as the delivery format for this engagement; a conversion utility to CSV can be supplied as a separate professional-services item if required.

rationale: The section states it meets the retention part and how, but states the CSV export part will not be met as written and offers JSON as an alternative; the contract says that when a section meets part of a requirement and states an exception to another part, exception_stated is selected over complies or partial_or_deferred.

state.discount_request: We're happy to prepay the full year up front, so we'd like the annual prepayment discount applied. On top of that, since we came to you as a referral from Hollis Freight, who are already a customer of yours, we're hoping you can add a referral discount on the same order.
state.discount_policy: Discounts available: (a) an annual prepayment discount when the full contract value is paid in advance; (b) a volume discount for orders above the published seat threshold; (c) a nonprofit discount with proof of registered status. Not offered: discounts on implementation, training, or professional services. Resellers are not eligible for any discount and purchase at partner pricing. All discounts require approval from the regional sales director.

rationale: The request asks for two kinds of discount: the annual prepayment discount, which the policy describes, and a referral discount, which the policy neither offers nor names as not offered; the contract's order for multiple kinds (excluded, then not_covered, then described) selects not_covered_by_policy.
